title: NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU案例中比較Blackwell SM與調度與低精度Tensor路徑，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate blackwell sms and scheduling and low-precision tensor paths within the NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU case.

steps.title: SIMT 與執行羣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: SIMT and execution groups: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Blackwell SM與調度提出可反駁的SIMT 與執行羣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable simt and execution groups model and evidence record for blackwell sms and scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Blackwell SM與調度。GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 建立SIMT 與執行羣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify blackwell sms and scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU. GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of simt and execution groups, focusing on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
steps.observationEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
steps.check: 提交Blackwell SM與調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for blackwell sms and scheduling.

knowledge.title: SIMT 與執行羣
knowledge.text: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 本課架構對應：Blackwell SM與調度
knowledge.textEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Course architecture correspondence: Blackwell SMs and scheduling

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=2 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.8 TB/s、計算峯值 38 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=2 FLOP/byte, B=0.8 TB/s and compute peak 38 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

quiz.question: 就Blackwell SM與調度的「SIMT 與執行羣」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for simt and execution groups in blackwell sms and scheduling?
options: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。
所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization.
Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
quiz.explanationEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.

steps.title: SIMT 與執行羣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: SIMT and execution groups: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Blackwell SM與調度提出可反駁的SIMT 與執行羣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable simt and execution groups model and evidence record for blackwell sms and scheduling.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「SIMT 與執行羣」模型，檢查Blackwell SM與調度的兩個假想案例。對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous simt and execution groups model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving blackwell sms and scheduling. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
steps.observationEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
steps.check: 提交Blackwell SM與調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for blackwell sms and scheduling.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對低精度Tensor路徑提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for low-precision tensor paths.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識低精度Tensor路徑。專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 建立矩陣核心與精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify low-precision tensor paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
steps.observationEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
steps.check: 提交低精度Tensor路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for low-precision tensor paths.

steps.title: HBM 與資料重用：架構分析
steps.titleEn: HBM and data reuse: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對HBM與data reuse提出可反駁的HBM 與資料重用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable hbm and data reuse model and evidence record for hbm and data reuse.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識HBM與data reuse。算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。 建立HBM 與資料重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hbm and data reuse in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU. Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of hbm and data reuse, focusing on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.check: 提交精度等質能量比較的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for equal-quality energy comparison.

knowledge.title: 能耗與工作負載
knowledge.text: 利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。 本課架構對應：精度等質能量比較
knowledge.textEn: Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy. Course architecture correspondence: Equal-quality energy comparison

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=2 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.8 TB/s、計算峯值 38 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=2 FLOP/byte, B=0.8 TB/s and compute peak 38 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

quiz.question: 就精度等質能量比較的「能耗與工作負載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for energy and workload in equal-quality energy comparison?
options: 較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。
optionsEn: Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality.
quiz.explanation: 利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。 比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy. Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality.

summary: 以多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充解析NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU through die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設算術強度 I=2 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.8 TB/s、計算峯值 38 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
workedExample.textEn: Assume I=2 FLOP/byte, B=0.8 TB/s and compute peak 38 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(38,I×B)=1.6 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.
